text:
marta: Heads-up — since 09:12 UTC we're seeing node joins fail in eu-west due to keystore/audit lag. GPU warmup stuck, ~12% join failures so far. Anyone looking?
josh: I saw that. CloudWatch: S3 PutObject 5xx spikes and NATGW conn throttles around the same time. Looks like audit shipper egress burst.
li: Could be related to the firewall tighten rolled yesterday (ephemeral port narrowing). Might be blocking the shipper fallback.
amir: Audit shipper flipped to full flow sampling this morning to debug earlier gaps; egress qps jumped 1.8x and infra shaper started dropping. We hit the keystore path indirectly.
sre-bot: Alert: keystore-decrypt-error-rate >5% (10m). Incident queued, paging @oncall :rotating_light:
devon: Logs from a failed node: ```2026-03-21T09:17:22Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: KMS::ThrottlingException``` so it's KMS/egress throttling not purely auth.
ops-qa: Quick options: 1) raise KMS quota / request burst from cloud support, 2) reduce flowlog sampling/retention to cut egress, 3) route keystore traffic over PrivateLink to avoid NAT egress. All have tradeoffs (compliance & cost).
marta: Compliance will resist dropping sampling permanently. Short-term we need something that preserves audit evidence. PrivateLink for keystore + ship logs via VPC endpoint seems best short-term if we can spin it up quickly.
josh: I can provision the privatelink endpoint and endpoint policy in the eu-west account. Needs backend svc name and security review. I can test in staging first. ETA ~2h if approvals are fast.
li: Another mitigation: spread decrypt load across regional KMS replicas or use regional aliases so requests don't concentrate on single key replica. That requires a small config change in keystore service.
amir: Also propose a short-lived client-side cache for node init tokens (ttl 5m) to avoid repeated decrypts during warmup. Low-risk and reduces churn while we fix network path. devon can prototype.
devon: Will open a small PR for a short ttl token cache and an opt-in feature flag. If privatelink goes green we keep cache as fallback.
ops-qa: Agreed runbook: 1) lower flowlog sampling to 1% for 30m (emergency mitigation), 2) create privatelink endpoint for keystore in eu-west, 3) escalate KMS quota to cloud Support, 4) enable client-side cache. I've updated the runbook: https://go/release/keystore-flow-throttle (internal).
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-031-97 created and assigned to eng-infra + @oncall. Adding timeline and runbook link. :white_check_mark:
marta: Perfect. Keep cost numbers in the incident notes — compare NATGW burst egress vs endpoint monthly cost. I'll loop in compliance for a 2h carveout if needed. Thanks all.
